title: Server Essentials
description: All the mods you need to play on an SMP!
body:
## From the Creator of Engineered Realms, I Present to You:

📦 Server ESSENTIALS

A lightweight, multiplayer‑friendly utility pack for Fabric 1.21.x
Server ESSENTIALS is a streamlined Fabric modpack designed to enhance multiplayer gameplay without changing the core feel of Minecraft. It focuses on performance, quality‑of‑life improvements, builder tools, and optional utilities that make server play smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you're running a small private server, building megabases with friends, or just want a clean set of essentials for everyday play, this pack keeps things fast, functional, and familiar.
[Visit our Website! (Not up to date with this modpack yet.)](https://engineeredrealms.netlify.app/)
✨ Key Features

⚡ Performance & Stability

Optimized with Sodium, Lithium, Entity Culling, and other improvements to keep servers and clients running smoothly with minimal resource usage.

🔧 Quality of Life Enhancements

Clearer tooltips, better animations, improved UI, minimaps, chat improvements, and smarter inventory interactions — all without altering vanilla progression.

🛠 Builder‑Friendly Tools

Includes Litematica, WorldEdit, and supporting libraries for players who enjoy large‑scale builds, redstone projects, or collaborative construction.

🎮 Optional Player Utilities

This pack includes optional convenience tools such as AutoMLG, AutoFish, Bridging Mod, Freecam, and similar helpers.
These are intended for singleplayer or private servers where all players agree to their use.

🌍 Light Gameplay Tweaks

Small additions like Easy Magic, Veinminer, Universal Ores, and other subtle enhancements that keep the game fresh without overwhelming the vanilla experience.

🔊 Multiplayer‑Ready

With Simple Voice Chat, Web Chat, and networking libraries included, Server ESSENTIALS is built for smooth communication and cooperative play.

📌 Current Status: Beta 0.1.0

This is an early beta release. Expect refinements, instabilities, modlist adjustments, and configuration improvements as the pack evolves.
